asset.name: ScrollArea
asset.description: The accessible scroll container preserving native scrolling and keyboard behavior while offering optional custom indicators and stable layout.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

suggests.reason: Boundary shadows help only where clipped content is not otherwise obvious, and they cost a scroll subscription.
